scope: Actual exclusive-lock Ryzen7 9700X, CPU2, 12 linked image placements, three plain process copies or one conditioned copy, three rotated rounds. All observations retained; no performance exception approved.
qualifications: Ranges are observed unpaired Cartesian extrema, not confidence intervals or proof of equivalence.
Conditioned groups have one copy per placement; within-placement copy spread is unavailable.
Inner benchmark counters do not provide enabled/running equality.
Ratios derived from printed rounded fields do not gain precision. reportedThrottle is retained as printed; no energy or frequency cause is inferred.
